description: Import Elementor Image Optimizer's work (no re-encoding): its optimized sizes become [cvrt] Media records, links to its originals are rewritten to the current files, and its originals move into the backup store, up to limit attachments per call (repeat until done, each step is resumable). Changes records, content links and files on the site; run media_eio_dry_run first. Needs confirm: true, otherwise the site refuses with 400.

limit.description: Most attachments adopted in this call, 1..500
